summary_for_children: Al-Kawthar tells the Prophet (peace be upon him) he has been given abundance and to pray and sacrifice to Allah alone.
environment_concept: An orchard with full baskets, a sign of good things given. It is not a picture of al-Kawthar, which is not shown. A small clean terrace for prayer stands at its edge. No person is shown.
architecture_and_scenery: Fruit trees with full baskets, a raised stone prayer terrace with a low wall.

story_library.source: Owner's 'Quran Adventure — Children's Story Library' (2026-11-04), first-draft narration for ages about 7-12
story_library.title: The Gift of Abundance
story_library.children_narration: Allah tells Prophet Muhammad that He has granted him Al-Kawthar, an extraordinary abundance. The surah calls for prayer and devotion. It reminds us to respond to Allah's blessings with gratitude and worship.

world_idea.title: The Garden of Gratitude
world_idea.description: A peaceful, flowing-water-inspired environment representing gratitude through artistic symbolism. Avoid claiming that the game depicts Al-Kawthar's actual unseen reality.

story_library.checks: Every reference exists in the verified text (checked 2026-11-04). Narration is draft, written by the owner, not reviewed by a scholar.
story_library.rule_conflicts_resolved: Al-Kawthar is not pictured. The garden stream is an ordinary stream, labelled.
